note: Sierra NF campground spread along Dinkey Creek in pine and cedar forest, off Dinkey Creek Rd east of Shaver Lake; the loops stretch about 2 km along the road. Paved spurs. Granite swimming holes (The Slicks, Honeymoon Pool) in the creek; the Dinkey Creek Inn nearby has a small store and pay showers while it is open. No cell service. --Claude
